name: 9router-app

scripts.deploy:router: node scripts/build-cloudflare.mjs --config wrangler.router.toml && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.router.toml

comment_better_sqlite3: kept in optionalDependencies so npm install doesn't fail on systems without build tools — sql.js is used as fallback at runtime
comment_aws_sdk_credential_providers: kept in optionalDependencies (npm still installs these by default) and imported lazily in shared/awsCredentials.js — only AWS Bedrock connections using profile/SSO mode need it; static accessKeyId/secretAccessKey connections never load it
comment_pg: kept in optionalDependencies and imported lazily in lib/db/adapters/postgresMemoryAdapter.js — only Postgres deployments (DATABASE_URL / POSTGRES_URL set) need it; SQLite is the default driver. It must be a declared dependency because the bundler resolves the dynamic import at build time even though the runtime path is opt-in
comment_playwright_core: devDependency only (keeps end-user installs small); open-sse/services/lazyRuntime.js downloads it + wreq-js on first use into <DATA_DIR>/runtime. playwright-core ships no browser binaries (run `npx playwright-core install chromium` or point OBSCURA_CDP_ENDPOINT/cloakbrowser at a stealth engine)
comment_cloudflare_tooling: the Cloudflare scripts (build/deploy/upload/preview) and wrangler.toml need these two binaries. They were only ever installed manually, so every npm install pruned them and broke build:cloudflare — declare them so a clean install is self-sufficient. opennextjs 1.20.5 is the newest whose peer range covers our next 16.3.6
